cards.sentence: Jag har rest från Sverige till Barcelona på en jobbresa.
cards.sentence_en: I've travelled from Sweden to Barcelona on a business trip.
cards.note: Also a noun: en resa = a trip. jobbresa = business trip.

cards.sentence_en: I'm not on holiday.
cards.note: vara på semester = be on holiday. Swedes take long summer semester in July.

cards.forms: passar på · passade på · har passat på
cards.english: to take the opportunity, to make the most of
cards.sentence: Jag passar på att göra en video till er.
cards.sentence_en: I'm taking the opportunity to make a video for you.
cards.note: Very common: Passa på! = Grab the chance!

cards.sentence_en: Excuse my pronunciation.
cards.note: Verb: uttala = to pronounce. Ursäkta = excuse (me).

cards.sentence_en: I speak neither Catalan nor Spanish.

cards.sentence: Det har en väldigt stor fin fontän.
cards.sentence_en: It has a really big, nice fountain.
There's something spraying water.

cards.forms: tar kort · tog kort · har tagit kort
cards.sentence: Här står massa turister och tar kort på monumentet och fontänerna.
cards.sentence_en: Lots of tourists are standing here taking photos of the monument and the fountains.
cards.note: ett kort = a photo (also a card). Same as ta en bild.

cards.sentence: En person som reser och tittar på fina platser och saker är turist.
cards.sentence_en: A person who travels and looks at nice places and things is a tourist.

cards.sentence: Den här turisten har en hatt på sig.
cards.sentence_en: This tourist is wearing a hat.
cards.note: ha … på sig = to wear. A woolly hat is en mössa, a cap en keps.

cards.forms: tar av · tog av · har tagit av
cards.sentence_en: I can take off the hat.
cards.note: Opposite: ta på (sig) = put on.

cards.sentence_en: Now the tourist is filming.

cards.sentence: Jag har byxor och han har shorts.
cards.sentence_en: I'm wearing trousers and he's wearing shorts.
cards.note: Usually plural: ett par byxor = a pair of trousers.

cards.sentence: Han har vita skor och svarta strumpor.
cards.sentence_en: He has white shoes and black socks.
cards.note: en sko · skor = shoe.

cards.sentence_en: The plant grows out of a pot.
cards.note: ur = out of. blomkruka = flowerpot.

cards.sentence: Och den här delen av monumentet är det hästar.
cards.sentence_en: And on this part of the monument there are horses.
cards.note: en del can also mean 'some': en del människor = some people.

cards.sentence_en: A waterfall.
cards.note: vatten + fall; vattnet faller = the water falls.

cards.sentence: Vattnet rinner ner på de här stora stenarna.
cards.sentence_en: The water runs down over these big stones.
cards.note: Strong verb: rinna – rann – runnit. Näsan rinner = my nose is running.

cards.sentence: Här är ett staket så jag inte kan hoppa i vattnet.
cards.sentence_en: Here's a fence so I can't jump into the water.
I can't jump into the water.
A door like that is called a 'port'.
cards.note: False friend: not a harbour (= hamn). portkod = the door code for a building.

cards.sentence_en: Now I carry on up the stairs.
cards.note: upp för trappan = up the stairs; ner för = down.

cards.sentence_en: That's a palm tree.
cards.note: Also just en palm · palmer.

cards.sentence: Nu har jag gått till toppen av monumentet och kan titta ut över hela parken.
cards.sentence_en: Now I've walked to the top of the monument and can look out over the whole park.
cards.note: Toppen! on its own = Great! Excellent!

cards.sentence_en: They're boxing.
cards.note: Ends in -s because two people do it to each other, like slåss (to fight) and träffas (to meet).

cards.sentence: När man boxas då slår man varann.
cards.sentence_en: When you box, you hit each other.
cards.note: varann is the everyday spoken form of varandra.

cards.sentence_en: You shouldn't hit others.

cards.english: to train, to practise, to work out
cards.sentence: Kanske bara om du tränar boxning som de.
cards.sentence_en: Maybe only if you train boxing like them.
cards.note: Jag tränar on its own = I work out, I go to the gym.

cards.sentence_en: It has wings.

cards.forms: lutar sig · lutade sig · har lutat sig
cards.sentence_en: He's leaning against the fence.
This is a duck.
cards.note: A wild duck is also en and · änder.

cards.sentence_en: You shouldn't feed the ducks.
cards.note: From mat = food.

cards.sentence_en: That person is swimming in water.

cards.forms: går vidare · gick vidare · har gått vidare
cards.english: to move on, to go further
cards.sentence_en: Now I go further into the park.
cards.note: vidare = onward, further. Also figurative: gå vidare = move on (in life).

cards.sentence_en: Here's a bin.
cards.note: sopor (rubbish) + tunna (barrel).

cards.sentence_en: Here you can throw away rubbish.
cards.note: sopor = rubbish, trash (plural).

cards.sentence: Här är en bänk och där är flera bänkar.
cards.sentence_en: Here's a bench and there are several benches.
Behind the bench there's a bush.

cards.sentence: Det är massa folk som har samlats.
cards.sentence_en: There are lots of people who have gathered.
cards.note: samla = collect something; samlas = come together.

cards.sentence_en: It's called a crowd.
This is an exit.
cards.note: Opposite: ingång = entrance. For cars: utfart.

cards.sentence_en: That's called a triumphal arch.
cards.note: en båge = an arch, a bow.

cards.sentence: Jag är lång men trädet är högt.
cards.sentence_en: I'm tall but the tree is tall (high).
cards.note: People are långa; trees, buildings and mountains are höga.

cards.sentence_en: They're going to play drums.
And he has a flag.
